source_read: https://menus.tenkites.com/hickorys/hickorys03 (all 6 tabs re-downloaded 2026-10-08, plus a Playwright DOM read of every dish modal and the page's JSON-LD; robots.txt allows)
notes: The live page changed since the 6 Oct read, so hickorys.py was updated and re-run: new tab names (Main Menu, Brunch & Lunch, Non Gluten), new sections (Subs, Steak & Fish, Lunch, Soda Floats), 190 -> 225 items (about 35 added, 23 removed, 50 with changed recipes/numbers); fetch now takes each tab's data-menu-identifier from the base page. Every one of the 225 published rows matches the rendered modal exactly (kcal, protein, carbs, sugars, fat, saturates, salt) and the JSON-LD (kcal, protein, carbs, fat, saturates, sugars), and every Contains line, cereal and nut kind matches. IMPORTANT: the page no longer prints any 'May contain' line for a published dish (about 100 dishes had one on 6 Oct), so allergen_guide may_contain_published is now no: the app says the guide gives no traces information. One held back: PIP Apple, Orange & Mango (page prints 68 kcal, its macros add to about 714). Alabama Chocolate Fudge Cake (no gluten marked) kept because the chain's own Non Gluten menu lists the same dish; Fro-Co Straight Up kept because the page tags it Vegan; The Hickory's Hot Dog 'brioche style' roll shows no egg mark (not clearly contradicted).
